name: Wild Speaker
text:
**Wild Speaker**

The Bleaching enhances a gnome’s ability to communicate with the natural world.

**Prerequisites**: Bleachling racial trait, gnome.

**Benefit**: You can use your speak with animals spell-like ability at will.
